title: ID60012: Power Infrastructure
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Investment criteria, NPV, benefit cost ratio, payback period, investment
appraisal; estimation of project cash flows; risk analysis; cost of capital;
long term finance.
Project scheduling: delay and cost in projects, project planning through
network analysis.
operational planning: inventory management, safety stock/EOQ, production
scheduling and complaint resolution.
Environmental Impacts: Water, soil, air. water pollution. land degradation. air
–borne pollutants: gaseous and particulates; remediation and control. impacts
on community: job and habitat loss. Introduction to corporate social
responsibility.
